races.display_title: Coral 'Daily Rewards Shaker' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A typically interesting novice for the track with AQUA BLEU selected to come out on top. Warren Greatrex's 4-y-o boasts plenty of experience having scored 3 times in junior hurdles last season and with his Aintree reappearance second under his belt, he's interesting now tackling a longer trip. Well Achieved landed his only start in points and is respected, with recent course runner up Sappingirl and returning Trial by Jury others commanding plenty of respect. AQUA BLEU (IRE) WELL ACHIEVED (IRE) SAPPINGIRL (IRE)

races.display_title: Play Coral 'Racing-Super-Series' Mares' Novices' Hurdle (Listed) (GBB Race)
races.verdict: FAIRY PARK seems a bit of an edgy sort but she looked a good prospect on the evidence of her 2 bumper efforts last season, which she duly confirmed when hammering a next-time-out winner on her Ffos Las hurdling debut, and strikes as the type to go on to much better things. Expensive point recruit Royal Response impressed over C&D earlier in the month and is open to plenty of improvement, too, while the scopey Ti'mamzel shouldn't be taken lightly as a dual listed bumper winner. FAIRY PARK (IRE) ROYAL RESPONSE (IRE) TI'MAMZEL (FR)

IDAHO SUN was seen to better effect than subsequent Supreme third Mydaddypaddy when accounting for him in the Grade 1 Formby at Aintree when last seen, but that form still makes him look well treated from an opening mark in the early 140s, so there's every reason to believe he can maintain his unbeaten record over hurdles. races.verdict: ARTHUR CARROT had a bit more in hand than the final margin indicates when accounting for stablemate Bacha at Lingfield the previous week, so a 6 lb higher mark looks well within his compass, especially as it's doubtful we've seen the best of him yet. Odegaard has shaped well on both his nursery outings and is one to take seriously, while last-time-out winner Thai Baht should have the race run to suit again on her first try at 7f. ARTHUR CARROT ODEGAARD THAI BAHT

A low-mileage 4-y-o, he firmly appeals as the type to rate higher still and is selected to defy the handicapper again. Ancient State has been a fine advert for the Adam Kirby yard this year and is feared, whilst a pace duel could well bring admirable veteran Baldomero into contention late in the piece. races.verdict: HEY NOW shaped well on his return when fourth at Wexford and with this longer trip a likely big plus, he edges the vote in this highly competitive handicap.
